verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published uptime SLA figure and no public status page for real-time incident status. The only related item is the sandboxes page noting that a sandbox is not covered by the SLA. That implies an SLA exists somewhere but documents neither its terms nor any status page, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
